caption: The drawing depicts a small wooden shed or cabin painted in shades of green with red-brown trim on the edges, base, and roof. The building is rectangular with a slanted roof, and the perspective shows two sides. The left side features an open door through which a bear standing upright is visible, dressed in blue overalls and a yellow shirt. The side wall has several objects hanging on it: a black object resembling an animal skin or pelt, a paddle-shaped object, a brush or broom, and a round rake-like tool. There is a square window with four panes on the right-side wall, one pane appears broken or has a hole. The wooden planks of the shed have a weathered, streaky appearance with darker green and brown lines, and the structure sits on a base of the same reddish-brown color as the trim. The background is plain, off-white, and unembellished. The artist's name, "Einat Helberg," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Mechanical Bank
